name: opencode-models
description: Model routing, account policy and configured transport guards
about: Guards which models a session may run. It blocks unlisted providers and models for task and subagent spawns, refuses a mid-session model switch that breaks the access policy, serves the configured model list and instruction files, and starts the local jev bridge that answers judge and permission questions on a free or paid route.
needs: the accounts in auth.json that it guards
an OpenRouter key in auth.json only for the paid jev route
